limitations: Provider pagination exhaustion and interior contiguity cannot exclude omitted prefix/suffix logs or prove receipt-root completeness.
Captured source digests establish consistency with the retained collector manifest; they do not authenticate the provider or replace independent chain evidence.
ERC20/721 event shapes are not proofs of deployed token standard compliance or actual balance changes.
All current checks are development/source validation; there is no attack rule, outcome tuning, independent incident claim, or native asset/price/balance inference.
resolved_prefreeze_findings: Aligned normalized per-log fields between collector and independent parser; chain/time remain bundle context.
Log emitter comes from address/address_hash; unrelated smart_contract/transaction recipient is not an emitter identity.
Timestamp normalization uses exact <=9-digit fractions rather than datetime microsecond truncation.
Freeze requires both source names and the accepted archive input hash.
scope: Read-only source/contract review and offline synthetic verification before new provider sample; not a real-data evaluation.
